sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for facility 234688 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: $25 per single site plus a $7 electric fee ($32); double site $40 plus $7 electric; group site $50. The $25 non-electric sites are all in White Oak Loop (Loop A), where 'Camping units ... are restricted to less than 20 feet in length due to the access road hill and turn', so a 23-ft motorhome needs a $32 electric site in Loop B or C. Senior/Access pass halves the basic site fee, not the electric fee.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/sherando-lake-recreation-area ('Family Campground: $25 per single site per night, plus $7 electric fee (some sites). $40 for the double site') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234688/rates (2026 Peak: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 25, STANDARD ELECTRIC 32) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234688 (notice 'Camping units in White Oak Loop (Loop A) are restricted to less than 20 feet in length'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: USFS: 'Campground open early April through late October.' Day use April 1 through December. (recreation.gov's 2026 rate season runs April 1 - October 30.)

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/sherando-lake-recreation-area ('Seasons of Use: Campground open early April through late October'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234688 (notice 'Electric hook-ups only in River Bend (Loop B) & Meadow Loops (Loop C). No water or sewer hook-ups are available.') + campsite catalog (30 of 31 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites list Electricity Hookup 50), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 65 sites: 31 electric in Meadow (C) and River Bend (B) loops, 'suitable for larger camping units and RV's' (catalog lengths to 40 ft, back-in), and 34 non-electric in White Oak Loop (A), restricted to units under 20 ft by the access road. Unlevel mountain ground.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234688 (Facilities description; Loop A notice) + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234688 (65 sites, Max Vehicle Length to 40 on electric sites, Driveway Entry Back-in), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Showers, flush toilets and drinking-water hydrants (not threaded) in each loop; a signed RV fill station with threaded hose and a trailer dump station. No firewood or ice for sale; mandatory food storage lockers (bears). Lakes allow electric motors and hand-carried boats only.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234688 ('Showers, flush toilets and drinking water hydrants are located in each loop', 'A trailer dump station is located along the main road', 'A potable water station with threaded hose (to fill RV tanks)'; notice 'Firewood and Ice is not available'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'All camping requires a reservation prior to arriving ... No first-come, first-serve sites.' recreation.gov or 1-877-444-6777. Gate code arrives in the confirmation email; gate closed 10 pm - 6 am. Check-in 1 pm, check-out 11 am; no refunds; no site switching. recreation.gov lists soft weekend/holiday minimums (not enforced rules).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234688 (description; notices; facility_rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, minWeekendStay 'soft') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/sherando-lake-recreation-area ('RESERVATIONS ARE REQUIRED FOR CAMPING'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'The America the Beautiful Interagency Senior (annual and lifetime) and Access Passes provide a 50% discount to the day use fee, and basic campsite fee (not hook ups).'

summary: Changed fees $25-$32 -> $32/$32: the $25 non-electric sites are all in Loop A, restricted to units under 20 ft. Confirmed 50-amp electric; added no water/sewer hookups, 65 sites to 40 ft (back-in), showers/flush toilets/water/dump, reservation-only (fcfs never), 14-night max, season early April - late October (no exact dates), Senior/Access 50% off base.
